answer: Stop sybils with a grove of frozen stakes and a gale audit. Each identity grows one grove: bonds rooted in distinct peers and locked in tundra, thawing only slowly, so a stake cannot be moved to cover a second identity. Influence requires a grove quorum of unrelated roots; clones sharing roots graft into one grove and split one share. Each epoch a gale sweeps each grove at random: any grove holding N cloned identities is slashed by the grove size, so N clones lose roughly N squared bonds while a lone honest identity risks one. Clones must rebuild every frozen root from zero.
